title: 第5章 别走平时那道门第6章 揭穿骗局
slug: 算命太准外国客户都哭着喊大佬
content_zh:
第5章别走平时那道门
他以为林熙把自己弄过来是打算灭了自己，但林熙却开口道：“会收拾屋子吗？”
小鬼一听疯狂点头，这会他敢说不会吗，
“嗯，帮我把屋子打扫一下，顺便帮我看着店门。”
说完，林熙直接拎着小鬼的魂魄将其放进了店里的一只等人高的纸人里。
纸人穿着大红大绿的套装，脸颊上还有两个圆鸡蛋一样的红胭脂团，虽然表层糊着的纸已经破破烂烂了，但骨架还在，丝毫不影响干活。
进到新身体里，小鬼先是惊奇，等意识到自己的新身体可以触碰到物体的时候，更是惊喜的表示：“大师放心，我一定圆满完成任务！”
林熙点点头，走出了店铺。
林氏风水铺在街尾最尽头的位置，尽头是一堵高墙，因此要想离开这条街还得绕到街口去。
从街尾走过去，沿途的店铺都大门紧闭，门口落叶灰尘堆积了一层又一层，一看就是多年没有人踏足。
唯独街口那家店还开着，林熙路过的时候店主人刚好去后屋拿货了。
等到店主人转身的时候，刚好看到一道残影掠过。
店主人一愣，意识到什么，身子顿时如筛糠般抖了起来。
那身影可是从街尾那边过去的啊！
这这这，这街上的东西竟然已经敢在白天出来了吗？
店主人赶紧掏出祖上传下来的铜钱贴在胸口。
呜呜呜，老祖宗可要保护我啊。
……
走出丧葬一条街之后，林熙便发现附近的街道不说人声鼎沸，但街上商铺正常开着，生意都还不错，客人也不少。
这还是林熙来到这个世界之后第一次逛街。

她来到这个世界的时候，正逢原主落水被救回躺在床上休养，这一休养就休养了一个星期，之后又在成年当日，也就是昨天，直接被父母赶出来。
他们说养她到成年已经是仁至义尽，又阴阳怪气的说她有老爷子留下的店铺，完全可以自己养活自己，绝口不提那铺子已经三年没人住过，且那条街近几年还频繁出怪事这些事情。
本身原主和父母的关系就不好，在爷爷去世前都是由爷爷抚养长大，开销用度都是老爷子一手包办，也就是三年前老爷子去世她才被林家父母带回家。
但两口子重男轻女，再加上从小就没在一起生活过，自然是没有任何感情，要不是知道原身未成年他们必须承担起责任，恐怕连家都不让原身回。
自然的，原身这三年在林家也没什么好日子，繁重的家务，父母动辄打骂，还被小她几岁的弟弟欺负，久而久之心情越发压抑，心中积怨不散，这才想不开跳水了结一生。
不过林熙到来之际就已经用体内最后一丝灵力为原主超渡化怨，送原主去投胎了。
灵力耗尽，不然她也不可能在床上躺了七天。
而在身体恢复的第一时间，她就毫不留情转身离开。
昨天一整天都耗在路上，她自然没有时间逛街。
当然，也没有钱。
原身最后一点私房钱都用来买了火车票，好在昨天举报人贩子有了五百块奖励，坐车花去十块钱，还剩四百九，但在路过街边一位乞讨老人的时候，林熙还捐了二百五。
靠算命卜卦获得的钱财她都会捐出一半，以此抵消泄露天机带来的五弊三缺。
所以这么一算，现在她身上只剩下二百四了，按现在的物价来看，这两百多块钱根本买不了多少东西。
第5章别走平时那道门
看来还得挣钱。
没想到有朝一日她竟然也会为钱财发愁，林熙只感慨命运奇妙。

Chapter 5 Don’t go through the usual door
He thought Lin Xi brought him here with the intention of killing him, but Lin Xi said, "Can you clean up the house?"
When the kid heard this, he nodded wildly. Would he dare to say no now?
"Well, help me clean the house and look after the store for me."
After saying that, Lin Xi directly took the little ghost's soul and put it into a tall paper man in the store.
The paper man wears a bright red and green suit, and there are two round egg-like red rouge balls on his cheeks. Although the paper on the surface is torn, the skeleton is still there, which does not affect the work at all.
Entering the new body, the kid was surprised at first. When he realized that his new body could touch objects, he even expressed surprise: "Don't worry, master, I will complete the task successfully!"
Lin Xi nodded and walked out of the store.
Lin's Feng Shui shop is located at the end of the street, which ends with a high wall, so if you want to leave the street, you have to go around to the intersection.
Walking from the end of the street, all the shops along the way were closed, and layers of fallen leaves and dust accumulated at the door. It looked like no one had set foot there for many years.
Only the store at the corner of the street was still open, and when Lin Xi passed by, the owner happened to go to the back room to get some goods.
When the shop owner turned around, he happened to see an afterimage passing by.
The shop owner was stunned, and when he realized something, his body suddenly started shaking like chaff.
That figure passed from the end of the street!
Do these, this, these things on the street dare to come out in the daytime?
The shop owner quickly took out the copper coins handed down from his ancestors and stuck them on his chest.
Woohoo, my ancestors have to protect me.
…
After walking out of the funeral street, Lin Xi found that the nearby streets were not only bustling with people, but the shops on the street were open normally, business was good, and there were many customers.
This is Lin Xi's first time shopping since she came to this world.
When she came into this world, the original owner fell into the water and was rescued and was lying on the bed to recuperate. This recuperation lasted for a week, and then she was kicked out by her parents directly on the day of adulthood, which was yesterday.
They said that they had done their best to raise her until she reached adulthood, and they said in a weird way that she had the shop left by the old man and could support herself. They never mentioned that no one had lived in the shop for three years, and that there had been frequent strange incidents on that street in recent years.
The relationship between the original owner and her parents was not good. She was raised by her grandfather before his death, and all the expenses were taken care of by him. It was only after his death three years ago that she was brought home by the Lin family's parents.
However, the couple favored boys over girls, and had not lived together since childhood, so naturally they had no feelings. If they had not known that the original person was underage and they had to take responsibility, they might not have even allowed the original person to return home.
Naturally, the original person had not had a good life in the Lin family in the past three years. She had to do heavy housework, her parents often beat and scolded her, and she was bullied by her brother who was a few years younger than her. As time went by, her mood became more and more depressed, and her resentment lingered in her heart, so she couldn't think of ending her life by diving.
However, when Lin Xi arrived, she had already used the last bit of spiritual power in her body to transcend the resentment of the original owner and send him to be reincarnated.
Her spiritual power was exhausted, otherwise she would not have been able to lie in bed for seven days.
And as soon as her body recovered, she turned around and left without mercy.
She spent the whole day on the road yesterday, so she naturally didn't have time to go shopping.
Of course, there is no money either.
The last bit of my personal money was used to buy train tickets. Fortunately, yesterday I got a reward of 500 yuan for reporting human traffickers. I spent 10 yuan on the train and had 490 yuan left. But when I passed an old man begging on the street, Lin Xi also donated 250 yuan.
She would donate half of the money she gained from fortune telling to offset the disadvantages and disadvantages caused by revealing the secrets.
So after this calculation, she now only has 240 yuan left with her. Judging from the current prices, more than 200 yuan can't buy much at all.
5thDon't go through the usual door
It seems that I still have to make money.
Unexpectedly, one day she would also worry about money. Lin Xi only lamented that her fate was wonderful.
